title: Expanding on naval blockade, US military looks to restrict Iranian land commerce
gist: US CENTCOM launches Task Force Iron Gate to choke Iran's land and Caspian Sea smuggling routes, extending a months-long naval blockade that it says has blocked over $25bn in Iranian crude exports; a Reuters probe found Iran imported at least $2bn of hardware via Russia, Central Asia and China despite the blockade, while US midterm losses and intelligence doubts about renewed strikes complicate escalation.

themes.theme: Task Force Iron Gate: blockade moves onshore

insights.claim: The US military is launching Task Force Iron Gate, based in Tampa, Florida, to crack down on Iran's movement of advanced weapons and sanctioned material over its land borders and through the Caspian Sea.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Sanctions enforcement extends from maritime to land/Caspian corridors — raises risk for Russian, Central Asian and Chinese counterparties trading with Iran.
